provenance_note: Earlier user-library report REPORT_RU(1).md dated 2026-09-05 supplied H1-H3. Current Python controls were implemented and replayed separately. The report is not treated as a Lean certificate.

records.claim: A feature collision with different labels precludes an exact decoder.
limitations: Conditional on an actual feature collision and different labels.

records.claim: A common binary prediction on each equally weighted opposite-label pair has exactly one correct observation per pair.
limitations: An elliptic-curve involution and probability-measure bridge is not formalized here.
Additional non-invariant features or adaptive point queries are outside scope.

records.claim: For n=65537, the supplied synthetic prediction has exactly half of nonzero labels correct while satisfying 65534 of 65536 ordinary neighbor constraints and all negation constraints.
limitations: The concrete count and arbitrary-size counterexample family are not fully formalized in Lean.
No defect of parity lab is asserted.
This is known-scalar synthetic validation, not a public point decoder.

records.claim: An exact alternating successor relation at every natural index and an equal anchor determine equal sequences.
limitations: An infinite path statement, not an odd cyclic wraparound rule.
Uniqueness does not construct an efficient hidden-scalar evaluator.

records.claim: 17*179*2^128*10^36 < 9*(n-1) for the literal order parameter in the candidate.
limitations: Does not prove primality, ord_n(2), or the analytic cycle-label inequality.

records.claim: The prior report gives a cycle-label-only advantage upper bound of sqrt(r/2)*sqrt(n)*(1+ln(n))/(n-1) under its specified prime-modulus subgroup hypotheses.
required_obligations: Application to the precise observed feature and uniform distribution.
limitations: Do not infer absence of useful information in richer states.
